overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: WebAR experience for TD Bank VIP clientele celebrating the opening of One Vanderbilt, NYC. Delivered 3D modeling, visual effects, sprite sheets, 8th Wall integration, sound design, and spatial analytics.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Celebrate an architectural milestone for VIPs without app installs or friction, while showcasing scale and detail.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Owned 3D modeling, VFX, sprite sheets, 8th Wall integration, sound design, and analytics for an in-situ WebAR showcase of One Vanderbilt.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Exclusive, shareable WebAR for the TD Bank One Vanderbilt launch — premium spatial storytelling at true scale.

credits.label: Credits

credits.body: Designed for TD Bank — WebAR experience for TD Bank VIP clientele celebrating the opening of One Vanderbilt, NYC. Delivered 3D modeling, visual effects, sprite sheets, 8th Wall integration, sound design, and spatial analytics.
